title: Customer & Supplier Balance Ageing (Debtors / Creditors Buckets)

intro.title: Customer & Supplier Balance Ageing
intro.subtitle: Standardized 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, and 90+ days ageing buckets for working capital management

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 8, Part 4: Customer and Supplier Balance Ageing: Debtors and Creditors Buckets. Maintain healthy cash flow by identifying overdue receivables and upcoming distributor payables.
Navigate to Outstanding Balances under Accounting. Overdue invoices are grouped into standard thirty, sixty, ninety, and ninety-plus day aging buckets.
Analyze Customer Debtors to locate high-risk credit accounts requiring immediate payment reminders and follow-up.
Review Supplier Payables to monitor distributor invoices approaching cash discount dates or standard credit terms.
Send instant WhatsApp collection reminders directly to customers and export the aging schedule for cash flow forecasting. In Part 5, we explore Bank Statement Auto-Reconciliation!

outro.takeaway: Balance Ageing: Proactively manage working capital and mitigate bad debts with automated thirty-day aging buckets.
